title: yadgar/project
$comment: Closure is per chart (ADR-0850): this schema closes only the keys this chart owns; it does not close any chart's keys but its own. Every value stays untyped (no `type`, `enum`, `default` or `required`) — a toggle's type, a boolean, and every cross-key rule are `templates/render-checks.yaml`'s job (ADR-0797, ADR-0847), not the schema's — WITH ONE NAMED EXCEPTION: `tls.enabled` and `projectDb.tls.enabled` carry `type: boolean` and `required` (ADR-0845). ADR-0845 states that these two knobs have no default anywhere, including a chart default, so the schema itself refuses an absent, null or non-boolean value rather than leaving that to the render check (measured: this chart ships no default for either key to begin with, so a null and a never-declared key both collapse to the same `required` refusal). `templates/render-checks.yaml`'s own `hasKey`/`kindIs "bool"` arms for these same two leaves stay in the template for `--disable-openapi-validation` but are unreachable on the normal `helm template`/`helm install` path, where the schema answers first; what that template guard actually owns is `tls`/`projectDb.tls` ITSELF being null or not a map, which this schema's nested `properties`/`required` never inspects at all. `tls.clientAuth`, `tls.clientCaSecret` and `tls.clientCaSecretKey` are declared but stay untyped and optional (B-U5E): the binary does not read them yet, so neither the schema nor this chart enforces a value — only the render check's shape and off/optional/required pre-flight. Open maps, declared `{}` on purpose: `global` is the block the parent forwards to every module and the parent (not this chart) closes it; `resources` and `rollingUpdate` are bare Kubernetes maps whose optional sub-keys (e.g. `resources.requests.ephemeral-storage`) this chart never names, so an adopter is free to set any of them. Extras — keys a template reads that `values.yaml` does not declare, so declaring them here closes their parent block rather than leaving it open: `image.digest` is written by ci-release at package time (D65) and is absent from the committed `values.yaml`, which ships only `repository` and `tag`; `networkPolicy.scrapeFrom.namespace` is the one key an adopter sets under the `scrapeFrom: {}` this chart ships empty, to admit the metrics scrape (D54).
